response.sql: WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern` HAVING COUNT(`aCL IgG`) > 0), cross_pattern AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS avg_of_patterns FROM pattern_averages), above_average AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_acl_igg, p.avg_acl_igg - c.avg_of_patterns AS above_cross_pattern_avg FROM pattern_averages p CROSS JOIN cross_pattern c WHERE p.avg_acl_igg > c.avg_of_patterns) SELECT pattern, avg_acl_igg, above_cross_pattern_avg, ABS(avg_acl_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM above_average)) AS distance_from_above_average_patterns_avg FROM above_average ORDER BY avg_acl_igg DESC, pattern;
